groups.title: 2. How does hair loss and thinning hair occur?

items.html:
• Hair loss, alopecia, and thinning hair occur in both men and women ( * ) across all age groups for various reasons.
  • Genetics, hormones, age, childbirth, stress, and nutrition can all have a negative impact on fragile hair follicles.
  • As one gets older, hair often begins to lose its density and the once healthy follicles reduce their activity.

groups.title: 3. What exactly do hair fillers do?

groups.title: Hair fillers are the ultimate treatment for hair loss, and provide fuller and thicker hair.

items.html: Hair fillers are a method to address thinning hair by adding extra volume and texture to the hair roots. This is achieved by injecting a filler, usually based on hyaluronic acid, into the scalp. The hyaluronic acid promotes the growth of new hair and also strengthens existing hair, making it look fuller and healthier.

items.html: A Hair Filler treatment works with a powerful peptide complex. These peptides support your scalp, nourish the hair roots, and stimulate the follicles to become active again. Below you will find an overview of the peptides contained in Hair Filler and their effects.
items.text: A Hair Filler treatment works with a powerful peptide complex. These peptides support your scalp, nourish the hair roots, and stimulate the follicles to become active again. Below you will find an overview of the peptides contained in Hair Filler and their effects.

items.html: Peptides in Hair Filler and their action
items.text: Peptides in Hair Filler and their action

items.html:
Peptide Code Function
Decapeptide-10 CG-Keramin2 Nourishes the scalp and hair roots
Octapeptide-11 CG-Seperin Inhibits cell death caused by stress
Octapeptide-2 Prohairin-β4 Stimulates hair growth by (re)activating stem cells in hair follicles
Decapeptide-18 CG-WINT Generates new hair follicles
Decapeptide-28 CG-Rehairin Slows down the hair loss process
Oligopeptide-54 CG-Nokkin Slows down hair loss
Oligopeptide-71 CG-Edrin Promotes hair growth

items.html: Together, these peptides ensure that hair loss slows down, the quality of the scalp improves, and hair growth is stimulated again. This makes Hair Filler a treatment that not only works cosmetically but also provides support on a biological level.
items.text: Together, these peptides ensure that hair loss slows down, the quality of the scalp improves, and hair growth is stimulated again. This makes Hair Filler a treatment that not only works cosmetically but also provides support on a biological level.

items.html:
• Peptides are naturally occurring molecules in the skin that send signals to the most important skin cells.
  • When collagen is damaged, it signals cells to produce more.
  • In a young body, these peptides are produced naturally and at the right time.
  • It is now possible to “copy” these natural biological messengers. These copies are the biomimetic peptides that replace the skin’s natural molecules to maintain and regenerate it.

items.html: Aftercare for Hairfiller treatments

items.html:
Aftercare Guideline
Hygiene Wait 24 hours after the treatment to wash your hair.
Activity Wait 48 hours before exercising or sweating heavily after the treatment.
Heat / UV Avoid a hot shower, sauna, and tanning bed immediately after the treatment.
Touching & products Touch your scalp as little as possible and avoid styling products (for the first 24 hours).
Do not manipulate Do not massage or scratch the treated area.
Recovery The following day, you may resume your daily activities.
Maintenance We leave an interval of 3–6 months between maintenance treatments.

items.html: A hair transplant is perhaps the best-known solution for hair loss. In this procedure, hair follicles are moved from a donor area to zones where your hair is thinning or has fallen out. The transplanted hairs ensure new, permanent hair growth.

groups.title: What can I expect from a hair filler treatment?

items.html: Our doctor or nurse will analyze your scalp and hair before the treatment and create a treatment plan with you to help achieve the desired result. Clinical research shows that hair filler treatment yields visibly good results with 4 sessions at a 2-week interval. We are happy to advise you on the required quantity and treatment frequency. During the treatment, our doctor or nurse will administer multiple injections using a very fine needle into the chosen zone(s) on your scalp. Additionally, clients are recommended to use our hair serum daily during and after the Hair Filler treatment to maintain the result in the long term.

groups.title: What are the risks and complications of a hair filler?

items.html: A hair filler treatment at Sarasin Clinic is a very safe procedure. Complications are limited to some redness and mild skin irritation immediately after injection. These often disappear within 72 hours.

groups.title: What is the result of a hair filler?

items.html: The hair loss process stops after just the first treatment session with Hairfiller. Subsequent sessions stimulate blood circulation and significantly revitalize the hair follicles, thereby accelerating hair growth. Laboratory research has shown that peptide therapy revitalizes hair cells and hair follicles after treatment and stimulates blood circulation and hydration in the scalp. During clinical research into its effectiveness, patients were observed to experience an average increase in hair density of 22.3% and an average increase in hair thickness of 26% after one session every two weeks for a period of eight weeks (four sessions). A full Hair Filler treatment at Sarasin Clinic could counteract the hair loss process for up to approximately one year.

groups.title: Can you also use hair fillers for beard growth?

items.html: Hair fillers have been developed and researched for hair loss on the scalp. They are rarely used for beard growth. In principle, hair fillers can help activate existing or weakened hair follicles in the beard area, but the result varies from person to person. During a consultation, we would be happy to assess whether this is a suitable option for you.

groups.title: Do I need to see a dermatologist first?

items.html: No. You can start directly with an intake with us. We only recommend medical follow-up first in the case of “red flags” (sudden patchy hair loss, pain/inflammation, scarring, or clear medication/disease triggers).

groups.title: How many hair filler sessions are needed on average?

items.html: A hair filler treatment is always performed as a course. The minimum is 4 sessions, usually with an interval of 2 to 4 weeks. This is necessary because the active peptides and hyaluronic acid build up their effect step by step in the scalp and around the hair follicles. After the initial course, a maintenance session every few months can help maintain the result.
